none: PAS NLM-598D89: Roman Coin: Nummus of Valentinian II
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Valentinian II (375-392), Lyons mint issue of 379-383, Reece period 20. Obverse description: Bust diademed right, large eye. Obverse inscription: DN VALENTIN[---]. Reverse description: Wreath with vow: VOT/XV/MVLT/XX. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin, which is missing one third of flan. Diameter: 14.1mm, Weight: 1.34gms, die axis: probably 6
